# CIDEX 2024 — 青岛青智仪器有限公司 (Qingdao QINGZHI Instruments Co., Ltd.) — booth 1047

## Ringkasan

青岛青智仪器有限公司自 1988 年以来，一直专注于功率测量分析技术，为电机测试， 光伏逆变器测试，电动汽车测试，充电桩测试，电源测试，家电测试，发电机测试等电 气测试领域提供高性能的功率测量与分析仪器仪表。 Since 1988, Qingdao Qingzhi Instrument Co., Ltd. has been focusing on power measurement and analysis technology, providing high-performance power measurement and analysis instruments for motor testing, photovoltaic inverter testing, electric vehicle testing, charging pile testing, power supply testing, home appliance testing, generator testing and other electrical testing fields.
